prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Original Glaze theme Isoclinic Menagerie. Visual medium: cross-polarized photoelastic transmission imaging, impossible biological silhouettes made ONLY of precisely resolved luminous interference fringes. The contours are saturated cyan, citron, hot coral and ultramarine bands separated by thin near-black isoclinic lines; crisp optical-image detail and unusual flat translucent anatomy. It must visibly resemble an extraordinary polarisation experiment, not a normal 3D render, glossy glass object, crystal, fluid sculpture, drawing or rainbow gradient. No text, digits, symbols, UI, clock hands, dates, readings, frame, logos or watermark. Asset: ONE tall portrait phone wallpaper, 1290x2796 composition. Near-black ink-navy optical field. A huge asymmetric three-lobed stress membrane, an arched perforated optical lattice and one open spoked interference crown interact across the lower two-thirds; distinct scales, negative spaces and translucent overlaps. Microscopically thin coloured fringe trails connect them without clutter. Keep the top quarter and central left region mostly quiet near-black so phone widgets remain readable. Edge-to-edge artwork, no phone mockup. Opaque background.
